_note: Prompts and metadata for tools/gen-sound.py. Default backend is MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 (Apache 2.0, 48 kHz), so accepting one of these does NOT encumber the build. `kind` must match sound/library.js so the loop seam is applied to the same things. `tags`, `description` and `reuse` are copied into sound.json on --accept and exist so a FUTURE subject can find an effect without listening to all of them: reuse=generic travels anywhere, period is tied to an era, subject is tied to this story. Names not in library.js (oars, wading, fire, doorKnock) exist only as pack files — delete the sound.json entry and those cues fall silent rather than falling back to a synthesised version.

alarmBell.description: A heavy bronze bell rung hard and unevenly as a warning, strikes overlapping, long ringing tail.
alarmBell.prompt: a church bell rung hard and repeatedly as an alarm, heavy bronze bell in a wooden steeple, uneven strikes, long ringing tail

churchBell.description: A single large church bell tolling slowly, struck twice, ringing out over a quiet village.
churchBell.prompt: a single large church bell tolling slowly, deep bronze, struck twice, ringing out over a quiet village

hooves.description: One horse cantering steadily on a packed dirt road. A rider going somewhere, not a charge.
hooves.prompt: a single horse cantering steadily on a hard dirt road at night, hooves on packed earth, no other sound

wind.description: Low steady wind across an empty field at night. Hollow and continuous, no trees, no rain.
wind.prompt: steady cold wind over an open field before dawn, gusting, low and hollow, no trees, no rain

crowd.description: Many people talking at once outdoors in a town square. A continuous murmur with no word distinguishable.
crowd.prompt: a crowd of people talking outdoors across a town square, no individual words audible, uneven murmur

rigging.description: A wooden sailing ship at anchor: ropes creaking under load, blocks knocking, timber working.
rigging.prompt: wooden sailing ship at anchor, ropes creaking under load, blocks knocking, timber groaning, quiet water

oars.description: Wooden oars dipping and pulling through calm water, a boat moving steadily, water running off the blades.
oars.prompt: wooden oars dipping and pulling through calm water, a rowing boat moving steadily at night, water dripping from the blades, no voices

wading.description: Men walking through knee-deep water, heavy sloshing steps coming ashore onto a muddy bank.
wading.prompt: men walking through knee deep water, heavy sloshing steps wading ashore onto a muddy bank, no voices

fire.description: A bonfire of dry wood burning outdoors, crackling and spitting, steady flames.
fire.prompt: a bonfire of dry wood burning outdoors, crackling and spitting, steady flames, no wind, no voices

doorKnock.description: A fist knocking hard three times on a heavy wooden door at night. Someone waking someone up.
doorKnock.prompt: a fist knocking hard three times on a heavy wooden door at night, urgent, indoors quiet
